claim: The SAA-C03 exam is 130 minutes long for its 65 questions.
question: How long is the SAA-C03 exam?

qualifiers.scope: per exam; without the ESL +30 accommodation
qualifiers.condition: standard time; the ESL +30 accommodation adds a 30-minute extension

evidence.quote: This exam is 130 minutes long covering 65 questions.

note: The exam page states the value under the heading 'Exam duration' as the two-word line '130 minutes' (snapshot www/certification/certified-solutions-architect-associate, line 20), which the mechanical check M4 cannot accept as a quote. The AWS Training and Certification blog states the same value in a full sentence and is used as the evidence; the exam page remains the authority.

claim: The exam validates three tasks: design solutions that meet current business requirements and future projected needs, design architectures that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized, and review existing solutions and determine improvements.
question: Which three tasks does the exam guide say a candidate must be able to do?

values.display: review existing solutions and determine improvements
values.spoken: review existing solutions and find improvements

values.display: meet current business requirements and future projected needs

evidence.quote: The exam also validates a candidate's ability to complete the following tasks:
Design solutions that incorporate AWS services to meet current business requirements and future projected needs
Design architectures that are secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized

note: The third bullet 'Review existing solutions and determine improvements' is a 6-word list line without a period and cannot be quoted under M4; it is stated in the claim from the same list.

claim: Online proctoring is available for all AWS Certification exams from the test delivery provider Pearson VUE; the alternative is a Pearson VUE test center.
question: Where can the exam be taken, and is online proctoring available?

values.display: Online proctoring is available for all AWS Certification exams
values.spoken: online proctoring is available for every exam

evidence.quote: Online proctoring is available for all AWS Certification exams from our test delivery provider Pearson VUE.
We ask that you arrive at the test center 15–30 minutes before your scheduled appointment time.

note: The exam page line 'Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam' and the list line 'English 24x7' are too short to quote under M4.

claim: Exam voucher expiration dates cannot be extended, so check the voucher date before changing a registration.
question: Can an exam voucher expiration date be extended?

evidence.quote: If you paid for your exam using a voucher, verify the voucher expiration date prior to modifying your existing registration. Exam voucher expiration dates cannot be extended.

claim: Beta exam test takers can take the beta version only once, and then must wait until the certification exam becomes generally available to retake it.
question: How many times can a beta exam be taken?

values.display: take the beta version only once
values.spoken: a beta exam can be taken only once

evidence.quote: Note that beta exam test takers can take the beta version only once, after which they will need to wait to retake the exam when the certification exam becomes generally available.
